translations.simulation.pipeline.read.title: Reading the project
translations.simulation.pipeline.read.body: IDEM builds a structured picture of your project, separating what it knows from what it has to research, what stays uncertain, and what is missing.
translations.simulation.pipeline.discover.title: Factor discovery
translations.simulation.pipeline.discover.body: Agents look for the factors that can actually move this particular business, then rank them as critical, important, secondary or uncertain.
translations.simulation.pipeline.research.title: Data research
translations.simulation.pipeline.research.body: Prices, density, costs, regulation, seasonality: every external value arrives with its source, its date and how much confidence it carries.
translations.simulation.pipeline.simulate.title: Simulation
translations.simulation.pipeline.simulate.body: The engine combines factors and runs baseline, favourable and adverse scenarios, stress tests, and rare compound shocks.
translations.simulation.pipeline.analyse.title: Analysis
translations.simulation.pipeline.analyse.body: Viability index, robustness, confidence level, breaking points, the conditions viability depends on, and recommendations ranked by priority.

translations.simulation.offers.report.name: Full report
translations.simulation.offers.report.body: The detailed analysis and recommendations, for a simulation you already ran.
translations.simulation.seo.title: IDEM Simulator — Test your business before you launch it
translations.simulation.seo.description: Simulate the viability of your project before you invest. IDEM researches the factors that influence your business, runs scenarios and stress tests, finds where your model breaks, and delivers a detailed report with the conditions success depends on. Import your business plan or start from an IDEM project.
translations.simulation.seo.keywords: business simulator, test business viability, business plan simulation, startup stress test, startup risk analysis, AI feasibility study, viability index, business simulation Africa, validate a business idea, IDEM Simulator
translations.simulation.hero.title: Test your business before you {$START_TAG_SPAN}launch{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN} it
translations.simulation.hero.description: An idea can look excellent on paper and still fail once it meets the market. IDEM looks for the factors that can genuinely influence your business, simulates several possible futures, and shows you where your model breaks.
translations.simulation.fan.title: Fan of simulated trajectories
translations.simulation.fan.desc: From a single project, the engine lets many trajectories diverge. A minority stay above the viability threshold; most fall below it.
translations.simulation.wall.title: A business does not run on five variables
translations.simulation.wall.body: It runs on dozens, sometimes hundreds of factors, and they are never quite the same from one project to the next.
translations.simulation.wall.more: and many more, depending on your sector
translations.simulation.how.title: What IDEM does when you start a simulation
translations.simulation.how.body: This is not a conversation with an AI. It is a five-stage analysis.
translations.simulation.sectors.title: Factors depend on the business, not on a template
translations.simulation.sectors.body: Two businesses, two worlds. A fixed list of twenty variables applied to everyone would describe neither of them properly.
translations.simulation.stress.title: The point is not to reassure you. It is to find where the model breaks.
translations.simulation.stress.body: IDEM deliberately puts your business through hard situations, then tells you which ones it cannot take.
translations.simulation.stress.closing: If the conditions are genuinely bad, IDEM answers NO-GO. And it explains why.
translations.simulation.readout.title: An index, never on its own
translations.simulation.readout.body: An index of 72 backed by solid data and an index of 72 riddled with uncertainty do not mean the same thing. IDEM always shows both together.
translations.simulation.readout.robustness.def: How well the model keeps holding as the factors deteriorate.
translations.simulation.readout.confidence.def: The quality of the data the analysis rests on, assumptions included.
translations.simulation.readout.uncertainties.def: What the simulation could not establish, and what still has to be checked on the ground.
translations.simulation.readout.card.label: Simulated viability index
translations.simulation.readout.card.caveat: This index measures how robust the project is across the scenarios that were run. It is not a prediction of success.
translations.simulation.evidence.title: Every figure says where it came from
translations.simulation.evidence.body: Observed data, a derived estimate and an assumption are not worth the same. Blurring them would give a false impression of precision.
translations.simulation.evidence.data.label: Data
translations.simulation.evidence.data.body: An observed, published figure with its source and its date. Fuel prices, urban density, exchange rates.
translations.simulation.evidence.estimate.label: Estimate
translations.simulation.evidence.estimate.body: A value derived from comparable data, when nothing direct exists for your market.
translations.simulation.evidence.assumption.label: Assumption
translations.simulation.evidence.assumption.body: A deliberate choice by the engine, flagged as such, because no reliable data was available.
translations.simulation.report.title: The report answers one question
translations.simulation.report.body: What could make this project succeed or fail, and what should I change?
translations.simulation.report.note: Not "improve your marketing". Rather: acquisition cost is the model's main weakness, test an organic channel before raising the ad budget. Expected impact high, priority critical, confidence medium.
translations.simulation.loop.title: A simulation is not an endpoint
translations.simulation.loop.body: Change your price, your target customer or your funding in IDEM, run it again, and compare the two versions. What moves is not your chance of succeeding: it is how much strain your model takes.
translations.simulation.entry.title: Two ways to start
translations.simulation.entry.project.title: From an IDEM project
translations.simulation.entry.project.body: Business plan, market analysis, financial forecasts and business model are already there. The engine has less to ask for, and you pay less.
translations.simulation.entry.import.title: By importing your business plan
translations.simulation.entry.import.body: PDF, DOCX or plain text. IDEM extracts the activity, market, target customer, prices and costs, then lets you fill in the gaps before you start.
translations.simulation.offers.title: What you are buying
translations.simulation.offers.body: Simulation is billed separately from the rest of IDEM: it spends external research, several agents and compute. The amount is shown and confirmed before anything starts.
translations.simulation.honesty.title: What IDEM Simulator does not promise you
translations.simulation.honesty.p1: The results are estimates based on the data, assumptions and scenarios available at the time of analysis.
translations.simulation.honesty.p2: A high index guarantees neither viability, nor profitability, nor the long-term survival of your business. A low index does not mean the project is impossible: it means that, in the scenarios that were run, some factors carry significant risk.
translations.simulation.honesty.p3: It is a decision-support tool. Not a prediction, not a guarantee.
translations.simulation.cta.title: Put your project under strain
translations.simulation.cta.body: Before you commit your time and your money, find out under what conditions your business can work and what could make it fail.

translations.simulation.how.card.label: Under the hood
translations.simulation.how.card.body: Several agents work in parallel: one reads the project, others research external data, another combines them into scenarios.

translations.simulation.report.caption: The report is delivered inside your project, next to the deliverables it was built from.

translations.simulation.stress.verdict.label: Verdict: no-go
translations.simulation.stress.verdict.body: When the conditions are genuinely bad, the engine says so, and lists exactly which scenarios the model could not survive.
translations.simulation.schema.description: Business viability simulator. IDEM researches the factors that can influence a project, runs scenarios and stress tests, finds where the model breaks, and produces a detailed report together with the conditions viability depends on.
translations.simulation.schema.feature4: Viability index with a confidence level
translations.simulation.faq.q1.question: Does IDEM Simulator predict whether my business will succeed?
translations.simulation.faq.q1.answer: No. The results are estimates based on the data, assumptions and scenarios available at the time of analysis. A high index guarantees neither viability nor profitability, and a low index does not mean the project is impossible.
translations.simulation.faq.q2.question: Do I need to have built my project in IDEM to run a simulation?
translations.simulation.faq.q2.answer: No. You can import an existing business plan as PDF, DOCX or plain text: IDEM extracts the activity, market, business model, prices and costs. Projects already built in IDEM get a reduced price, because the deliverables are already available.
translations.simulation.faq.q3.question: What does the simulated viability index measure?
translations.simulation.faq.q3.answer: It measures how robust the model is across the scenarios that were run: how well it keeps holding as the factors deteriorate. It is always shown together with a confidence level and the list of main uncertainties.
translations.simulation.faq.q4.question: Is simulation included in IDEM?
translations.simulation.faq.q4.answer: No, it is billed separately because it spends external research, several agents and compute. The amount is shown and confirmed before the run starts. The full report can be bought with the simulation or later.
